hypotheses.justification: The existing proof needs no nonzero assumptions: GammaH, gamma0Units, mem_GammaH_iff, Gamma0Map, and ZMod.unitsMap are defined for every modulus. The castHom argument also works for every modulus. Both NeZero binders can be deleted together; ZMod 0 is ℤ and ZMod 1 is a valid trivial ring, so these cases cause no exception.

The existing proof works unchanged without this binder, even when ℓ = 0: ZMod 0 is ℤ, and castHom and unitsMap still provide reduction to ZMod N. Gamma0 membership and the lower-right unit commute with this reduction exactly as in the proof. Both NeZero binders can be deleted together.
